$schema_note: Where the Property Financials statement files live and which entity / layout each folder or file feeds (plan T9b, part 1). Read by scripts/property-financials/lib/sources.ts. `pmFolders` are the property-management monthly exports (one statement per file for AF, one per 12-month window for CF / A12); their `entity` must be a config/entities.json id, or match an `excludedEntities` pattern in the account mapping (then the whole folder is skipped and reported, never opened). `entityStatements` are the top-level annual / YTD files named `P&L <year>[ YTD] -- <entity>.<ext>`: registry entities of kind `annual` (QuickBooks) feed the dataset; monthly-kind entities' annual files are cross-checked against the monthly sums only. Binary .xls (OLE2) files cannot be read by exceljs: they are looked up as `<folder leaf>__<basename>.xlsx` in the converted directory ($PF_CONVERTED_DIR / --converted; produced by convert-xls.ps1) and reported as unreadable when absent. The source directory is READ-ONLY.
